policy: Public sources inform palette and broad rhythm only. Original procedural illustrations; no copied seals, text, identity fields, barcodes or security features. Public availability is not a licence to redistribute source images. All thirteen jurisdictions now have directly visually inspected public specimens. Newfoundland and Labrador, Nova Scotia and Nunavut use explicitly identified third-party reproductions; several examples are historic and no current-edition coverage claim is made.

jurisdictions.edition: Government public specimen with 2018 issue field; not asserted latest
jurisdictions.observations: Direct government image inspected after retry with desktop User-Agent. Cyan fine-line upper and lower fields, cream/ochre mountain engraving through the centre, pale green forest and warm accents. Exact fine lines and official symbols are excluded from the original artwork.
jurisdictions.adaptation: Pale blue/ochre field, original mountain and river contours, wild rose spray; no exact Castle Mountain tracing.

jurisdictions.edition: 2017 public sample in contemporaneous news coverage
jurisdictions.observations: Government-credited sample reproduced by Global News inspected. Pale green spiralling field, blue left portion, blue floral cluster right and alternating green/blue waves at bottom. Original lighthouse is a regional addition, not an observed card graphic. Earlier CBC response was a 195-byte denial page, not an image, and was not treated as successful.
jurisdictions.adaptation: Original engraved coastal lighthouse, muted rock shelf, water and flowering stems.

jurisdictions.edition: Historic sample with 2007 issue field, predates 2009 announcement; not current-design evidence
jurisdictions.observations: Vendor composite image visually inspected. Licence has warm cream/yellow field, rose upper band and cool pale blue lower edge, delicate northern landscape/dogsled drawing. Small blurred reproduction limits detail. Official 2009 source separately describes saxifrage on the reverse; those observations must not be conflated with the older front specimen. Blue/lilac tundra design is original interpretation.
jurisdictions.adaptation: Original blue/lilac tundra terrace with saxifrage-like flowers. No inuksuk or official graphic reproduced.
